captionEn: Doudou offers flowers in praise of a friend, who bows happily.
captionZh: 豆豆送花稱讚朋友，朋友開心地鞠躬。
methodDescription: Built-in image_gen edit followed by LANCZOS resize from 1254 square to original 1024 square and RGB/WebP encoding. No CLI/API fallback.
generationPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: square vocabulary-card illustration for praise.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Make one minimal local edit: the smiling olive antenna character on the left must offer exactly TWO clearly distinguishable blue flowers together in the same existing outstretched hand, with naturally grouped stems. Retain the original blue flower and add one matching blue flower next to it, with separate visible flower heads so the count is unmistakably two. Keep the bouquet small and close to the original flower position.
Preserve both original olive antenna characters exactly as closely as possible, including the giver's smile, posture and hand and the recipient's happy bow, closed eyes and hands. Preserve the muted blue/green palette, cream paper background and texture, soft watercolor and pencil look, ground shadows, original square composition, tiny centered lower scene, original character sizes and positions, and very large whitespace. Change only the flower grouping. No extra characters, hands, text, ribbon, labels, or unrelated objects. Opaque background; desired final canvas 1024×1024.
cloudPixelReview: Final WebP independently inspected. Exactly two distinguishable blue flower heads and grouped stems are held in the left giver's existing hand. Both olive characters, smile, happy bow, closed eyes, original posture, large cream whitespace and watercolor composition remain visually consistent. Minor generative texture/outline differences outside the flowers mean preservation is not pixel-identical.
integrationRequirements: Fetch into the consuming executor, verify hashes/specifications and inspect actual image pixels.
Resolve the exact general praise image/caption consumer and any shared consumers; do not apply this caption to independent practice examples.
Preserve the original immutable asset and source approval evidence; add only precise guarded bindings.
Reopen actual App cards after normal update and closing/reopening, verify image/caption pairing, saved data and unchanged learning/custom progress.
Run relevant regression, lint, typecheck, build and exact new-commit CI before acceptance.
